blocker.detail: The V15.38 source baseline includes Beat Vault 22/22 local previews, authentic first-party Benny portrait, first-class Season 1/VST growth routes, and current QA hardening. Deploy once after the Vercel Hobby API quota permits; do not churn intermediate deployments.

blockers.detail: Choose whether the verified Vercel project domain should become the public canonical origin or whether a branded domain will be connected, and explicitly authorize switching the site from protected/noindex preview mode to public/indexable SEO mode.

featureGates.detail: Waitlist may collect interest via user-sent email. Free-shirt drawing entries must not open until official rules, dates and eligibility terms are published.
All 22 Beat Vault records now have site-hosted 30-second / 128 kbps audition previews. Restricted source masters remain private; only derived audition files are public.
Approved BillYen source assets are documented but not present as repository binaries. Direct profile uses a deliberate typographic fallback rather than generated or unrelated photography.
Vercel Web Analytics is optional. Current connector can read analytics but cannot enable the project-level feature.
Authentic first-party Benny Bundles profile portrait recovered from connected Drive and packaged as the canonical Artist hero, social-share image and structured-data image.
Season 1 waitlist captures size, social handle, style-direction preference and optional drawing-notification interest through a user-reviewed mailto handoff. Giveaway entry remains rules-gated.
Producer’s Tools collects DAW, OS, workflow pain point and feature priorities through a user-reviewed mailto handoff. No public download is represented until a tested build exists.
